records.title: REVISION OF FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE UNDER PMAY-G
details:
(a) to (d): To achieve the objective of 'Housing for all', the Ministry of Rural Development
is implementing the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G) for the construction of
4.95 crore houses with basic amenities by March 2029.
The Union Cabinet has also
approved the construction of 2 crore additional houses under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana
Gramin (PMAY-G) from financial year 2024-2025 to 2028-29 with unit assistance of ₹1.20 lakh
in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in North-Eastern Region (NER) States and Hill States.

records.title: Inordinate delay in approval of Greenfield Airports
details: (a) and (b): It was inter-alia stated that Ministry of Civil Aviation has received six proposals, namely, Parandur in Tamil Nadu, Puri in Odisha, Kottayam in Kerala, Raichur in Karnataka, Doloo (Cachar) in Assam, and Kota in Rajasthan, for grant of first Stage Clearance i.e.Site Clearance for development of Greenfield Airports and the proposals are under examination of Directorate General of Civil Aviation, Airports Authority of India and Ministry of Defence.
